// diagnostic

E0362

Compound assignment can't target a nested operator field.

What

Compound assignment can't target a nested operator field.

Why

Hooked compound assignment must read and write one stable place exactly once; nested field places are not yet represented by the operator assignment spine.

Fix

Bind the inner value, update it, then assign the whole inner value back.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0362: tests/ui/operator_nested_compound.stderr.
